Rankings show how teams compare within each region. Points summarize performance based on match results.
More points means a higher position in the table. Points are a rating, not a count of wins or a win percentage. Rank #1 is the highest-ranked team in that region.
Elo compares a match result with what the ratings predict. Beating a stronger team earns more points; losing to a weaker team costs more. Expected results usually move ratings less.
Compare points within the same region. Different regions have separate leaderboards, so a bigger number alone does not show which team is stronger across regions.
